title: Global classical solutions for the general planar Broadwell model with arbitrary velocity orientation: a fixed-point framework
summary: The present work extends a fixed-point framework previously developed for the standard planar four-velocity Broadwell model to the general four-velocity configuration with an arbitrary orientation of the discrete velocities. This provides a non-axis-aligned test of the framework and leads to a global-in-time existence and uniqueness result for classical solutions of the associated initial-boundary value problem in a rectangular domain.
